S5.text_en: Do not take ibuprofen until your heart doctor checks your kidneys again and says it is OK.
S5.text_tl: No tome ibuprofen hasta que su cardiólogo vuelva a revisar sus riñones y le diga que puede tomarlo.
S5.back_en: Do not take ibuprofen until your cardiologist checks your kidneys again and tells you that you can take it.

S12.text_tl: No beba más de 1,5 litros de líquido al día.
S12.back_en: Do not drink more than 1.5 liters of liquid per day.

add.text_en: Call the heart clinic at [PHONE_1] if your weight goes up more than 2 pounds in one day or 5 pounds in one week, or if your legs swell more.
add.text_tl: Llame a la clínica del corazón al [PHONE_1] si su peso sube más de 2 libras en un día o 5 libras en una semana, o si sus piernas se hinchan más.
add.back_en: Call the heart clinic at [PHONE_1] if your weight goes up more than 2 pounds in one day or 5 pounds in one week, or if your legs swell more.
